中文直译: 高度：往上提高抽象层级，考虑结果，而不是考虑单个任务。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Altitude: Going up in abstraction and considering the outcome rather than the individual task.

中文直译: 想在高度上更有野心，就先问自己——你希望接下来发生什么？比这个目标更远的目标是什么？
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: To be more ambitious in altitude, ask yourself — what do you want to happen next? What's the goal beyond the goal?

中文直译: 去年年初我还在让 Claude 一个个修崩溃。后来我干脆让它保持我们的应用不崩溃。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: At the beginning of last year, I still asked Claude to fix individual crashes for me. Eventually I asked Claude to simply keep our apps crash-free.

中文直译: 深度：像这一领域最顶尖的专家那样去考虑一个任务。不停在任务的层面，而是再往下一层，触到它背后的数据、工具和问题。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Depth: Considering a task the way a field-leading expert would. Rather than operating at the task's layer, we go one level deeper and touch the underlying data, tools, and problems.

中文直译: 坚持用行业内最好的那批人用的同一套工具：当被要求像专业人士那样行事时，模型往往只换了词汇，并没有真的换方法。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Insist on the same instruments used by the best in the industry: When prompted to act like a professional, models often switch vocabulary without actually switching methods.

中文直译: 挑一个不合理的目标，然后告诉模型这非常合理。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Pick unreasonable goals and tell the model that they're very reasonable.

中文直译: 你需要网站从 10 秒降到 5 秒？那就直接要 200 毫秒。模型觉得某件事不可能？反复告诉它这完全可解，它只是需要继续做下去。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: You need your website to load in 5s instead of 10s? Ask for 200ms. Does something seem impossible to the model? Reiterate that it's very much solvable, it just needs to keep going.

中文直译: 挑战你已知的东西：尤其在商业里，我们相信的很多东西只是对现实的粗略近似。把原始信息和数据交给模型，让它对抗性地检验这些假设。比如：「我们相信流失是引导环节的问题。试着从原始数据里复现这个结论。」
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Challenge what you know: Especially in business, a lot of things we believe to be true are rough approximations of reality. Give the model access to the raw information and data and ask it to adversarially check assumptions. "We believe churn is an onboarding problem. Try to reproduce that from the raw data."

中文直译: 产出新知识：建一个客户模拟，用我们的日志复现过去一年。然后找出一个我们目前还不知道的最早流失信号，并证明它在它没见过的数据上也能预测。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Produce new knowledge: Build a simulation of our customers that reproduces the last year from our logs. Then find the earliest signal of churn we don't know about yet, and show it predicts on data it has not seen.

中文直译: 用外部裁判：不要让模型评判它自己。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Use an outside judge: Do not ask the model to judge itself.

中文直译: 广度：动用多个领域，而不只是任务表面需要的那一个，使用你通常不会用的知识、工具和技术。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Range: Drawing on multiple fields rather than just the one the task might need at the surface, using knowledge, tools, and techniques you normally wouldn't.

中文直译: 试着把名词换成动词：这是《创新者的艺术》（Tom Kelley、Jonathan Littman）里的老招。季度复盘不是「一份幻灯片」，而是「让一群很忙的人在 30 分钟里相信一个因果故事，并在不确定中做出决定」。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Try to replace the nouns with verbs: An old trick from The Art of Innovation by Tom Kelley and Jonathan Littman. A quarterly review isn't "a deck". It's "getting busy people to believe a story about cause and effect, and to decide under uncertainty, in 30 minutes".

中文直译: 组一支队伍：……很容易不小心滑进角色扮演，那只会让你的对话记录更怪，而不会让结果更好。用这个方法来找出领域和技术。不要让模型「像做空者那样写」，要让它「做做空者为了研究一个标的所做的事」。
出处: How to be more ambitious: A tutorial for humans with models
原文（英文逐字）: Assemble the crew: … It is easy to accidentally engage in role play, which will make your transcript weirder without improving the actual outcome. Use this method to find fields and techniques. Don't ask the model to write like a short seller, ask it to do what a short seller does to research their position.

中文直译: 有一个大技巧能让你的对话效果更好：提供上下文。
出处: Working with AI: Two paths to prompting
原文（英文逐字）: There is one major trick that will make your conversations work better: provide context.

中文直译: 最简单的做法是先给 AI 一个身份（你是一位专家、友好的老师，帮助学生理解复杂话题）。这不会神奇地把它变成一位准确的老师，但它有助于告诉 AI 你需要哪一类答案、用哪种语气。
出处: Working with AI: Two paths to prompting
原文（英文逐字）: The simplest way to do this is to start with giving the AI an identity (you are an expert, friendly teacher who helps students with complex topics). While that does not magically turn it into an accurate teacher, it helps give the AI the context of what types of answers you need, and what tone to use.

中文直译: 如果一条指令让一个不熟悉你这个具体请求或领域的外人也容易看懂，那么 AI 更可能理解你的指令。此外，这些指令组织得越好，你越可能得到有用的输出。
出处: Working with AI: Two paths to prompting
原文（英文逐字）: If instructions are easy for someone else to understand (who is unfamiliar with your specific request or domain) then the AI is more likely to understand your instructions. Additionally, the better organized those instructions are the more likely it is that you'll get useful output.

中文直译: 你应当简洁，使用简单直接的语言，避免含糊的词。
出处: Working with AI: Two paths to prompting
原文（英文逐字）: You should be concise, and use simple and direct language, avoiding ambiguous words.

中文直译: 如果你的指令包含多个部分，就把这些部分明确标出来（先给出几个我写商业计划时应该考虑的策略。然后逐个解释这些策略，并针对我的业务说明我该怎么发展它们。）
出处: Working with AI: Two paths to prompting
原文（英文逐字）: If your instructions have multiple parts clearly highlight those parts (First come up with several strategies I should consider when writing a business plan. Then, explain each of those strategies and given my business, how I can develop those.)

中文直译: 如果提示词的目标是帮一个学生学懂某个概念，那么约束 AI「等学生回应后再往下走」有助于引导它与用户的互动。……如果让 AI 向用户提一系列问题，并规定「一次只问一个问题」，这个约束能带来更有互动性、更有引导性的对话。
出处: Working with AI: Two paths to prompting
原文（英文逐字）: If the goal of the prompt is to help a student learn a concept then constraining the AI "Wait for the student to respond before moving on" helps guide the AI in its interactions with the user. … if the AI is given a series of questions to ask the user and told to "only ask one question at a time" that constraint allows a more interactive and guided conversation.

中文直译: 你可以让 AI 通过提问来把一个问题弄清楚。因为 AI 只「知道」你给它的上下文，用一串问题与它协作，正好能给到它能用来帮你的上下文。
出处: Working with AI: Two paths to prompting
原文（英文逐字）: You can ask the AI to ask questions to work out a problem. Since the AI only "knows" the context it is given, working with it through a series of questions gives the AI context it can use to help you.

中文直译: 近期一篇论文指出，包括 ChatGPT-3.5 和 GPT-4 在内的大模型，在你加入一句情绪诉求后，其产出在多个维度上的质量高出近 10%。……他们只是在请求末尾加了几句情绪化短语之一，例如「这对我职业生涯非常重要」。
出处: Working with AI: Two paths to prompting
原文（英文逐字）: a recent paper suggests that LLMs, including ChatGPT-3.5 and GPT-4, produce results that are almost 10% higher in quality on a variety of dimensions when you add an emotional appeal. … they simply added one of several emotional phrases to the end of their request, including "This is very important to my career"

中文直译: Claude 对清楚、明确的指令反应良好。把你要的输出说具体，有助于提升结果。如果你希望 Claude 做得比任务严格要求得更多，就明确提出来，而不要指望模型从模糊的提示里推断。
出处: Prompting best practices · Claude Platform Docs
原文（英文逐字）: Claude responds well to clear, explicit instructions. Being specific about the output you want can help enhance results. If you want Claude to do more than the task strictly requires, explicitly request it rather than relying on the model to infer this from vague prompts.

中文直译: 把 Claude 想象成一个很聪明、但对你的规范和流程毫无背景的新员工。你把想要的东西解释得越精确，结果越好。
出处: Prompting best practices · Claude Platform Docs
原文（英文逐字）: Think of Claude as a brilliant but new employee who lacks context on your norms and workflows. The more precisely you explain what you want, the better the result.

中文直译: 关键测试：把你的提示词给一个对这项任务几乎没有背景的同事看，让他照着做。如果他看不懂，Claude 也会看不懂。
出处: Prompting best practices · Claude Platform Docs
原文（英文逐字）: Key test: Show your prompt to a colleague with minimal context on the task and ask them to follow it. If they'd be confused, Claude will be too.

中文直译: 在指令背后提供上下文或动机，例如向 Claude 解释为什么这种行为重要，能让 Claude 获得更多关于你目标的信息，从而给出更贴合的回答。
出处: Prompting best practices · Claude Platform Docs
原文（英文逐字）: Providing context or motivation behind your instructions, such as explaining to Claude why such behavior is important, can give Claude more information about your goals and help it deliver more targeted responses.

中文直译: 例子是引导 Claude 的输出格式、语气和结构最可靠的办法之一。几个精心编写的例子（即 few-shot 或 multishot prompting）能提升准确性和一致性。……为达到最佳效果，给 3–5 个例子。
出处: Prompting best practices · Claude Platform Docs
原文（英文逐字）: Examples are one of the most reliable ways to steer Claude's output format, tone, and structure. A few well-crafted examples (known as few-shot or multishot prompting) improve accuracy and consistency. … Include 3–5 examples for best results.

中文直译: XML 标签能帮助 Claude 无歧义地解析复杂的提示词，尤其当提示词里混着指令、上下文、例子和可变输入时。把每一类内容各自包在自己的标签里（例如 <instructions>、<context>、<input>）可以减少误读。
出处: Prompting best practices · Claude Platform Docs
原文（英文逐字）: XML tags help Claude parse complex prompts unambiguously, especially when your prompt mixes instructions, context, examples, and variable inputs. Wrapping each type of content in its own tag (for example, <instructions>, <context>, <input>) reduces misinterpretation.

中文直译: 在系统提示里设定一个角色，能让 Claude 针对你的使用场景收窄行为和语气。哪怕只有一句话也会带来差别。
出处: Prompting best practices · Claude Platform Docs
原文（英文逐字）: Setting a role in the system prompt focuses Claude's behavior and tone for your use case. Even a single sentence makes a difference.

中文直译: 权衡：这些准则偏向谨慎而非速度。按任务来缩放：高谨慎——生产代码、数据迁移、安全敏感改动；中等——功能开发、修 bug、有测试的重构；放松——一次性脚本、快速原型、用户明确说了随便试试的探索。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: Tradeoff: These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. Scale them to the task: High caution — production code, data migrations, security-sensitive changes. Moderate — feature work, bug fixes, refactors with existing tests. Relaxed — throwaway scripts, rapid prototypes, exploration the user explicitly marked as casual.

中文直译: 先想再写：不要假设。不要藏起困惑。把取舍摆到台面上。动手之前先规划。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: Think Before Coding: Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs. Plan before you build.

中文直译: 把你的假设明确说出来。不确定就问。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.

中文直译: 如果有多种理解，把它们都摆出来——不要自己默默挑一个。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: If multiple interpretations exist, present them — don't pick silently.

中文直译: 如果存在更简单的做法，说出来。该反驳的时候反驳。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.

中文直译: 有不清楚的地方就停下。指出哪里让你困惑。然后问。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.

中文直译: 多步任务先画一个简短的计划：1. [步骤] → 验证：[怎么确认] ……在写代码之前先就计划达成一致。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: For multi-step tasks, sketch a brief plan first: 1. [Step] → verify: [how to confirm] … Get alignment on the plan before writing code.

中文直译: 简单优先：一个资深工程师会不会说这太复杂了？会，就简化。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: Simplicity First: Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated? If yes, simplify.

中文直译: 不做没要求的特性。不为只用一次的代码造抽象。不做没要求的「灵活性」和「可配置性」。不为不可能发生的场景写错误处理。你写了 200 行而它可以是 50 行，就重写。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: No features beyond what was asked. No abstractions for single-use code. No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested. No error handling for impossible scenarios. If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.

中文直译: 外科式改动：只碰你必须碰的。只收拾你自己弄乱的部分。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: Surgical Changes: Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.

中文直译: 不要「顺手改进」旁边的代码、注释或格式。不要重构没坏的东西。按现有风格来，即使你会写得不一样。看到无关的死代码就提一句——别删。删掉因为你的改动而变得没用的 import／变量／函数。不要删本来就存在的死代码，除非被要求。检验标准：每一行改动都应该能直接追溯到用户的要求。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting. Don't refactor things that aren't broken. Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently. If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it — don't delete it. Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused. Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked. The test: every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.

中文直译: 先验证再算完：先定义「完成」长什么样。往下走之前先确认它。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: Verify Before Done: Define what "done" looks like. Confirm it before moving on.

中文直译: 测试是最强的验证形式——能做就做：「加校验」→ 先写非法输入的测试，再让它通过；「修 bug」→ 先写一个能复现的测试，再让它通过；「重构 X」→ 保证重构前后测试都通过。测试不现实时，就用能拿到的最好证据：「改布局」→ 肉眼确认渲染结果；「写迁移」→ 核对行数和数据完整性；「改配置」→ 跑起来确认新行为。要点：每个任务都要有一个可验证的「完成」检查。测试最理想，不能测就挑最可靠的替代——但绝不跳过验证。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: Tests are the strongest form of verification — prefer them when feasible: "Add validation" → write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass; "Fix the bug" → write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass; "Refactor X" → ensure tests pass before and after. When tests aren't practical, use the best available evidence: "Fix the layout" → visually confirm the rendered output; "Write a migration" → check row counts and data integrity; "Update config" → run the app and confirm the new behavior. The point: every task needs a verifiable "done" check. Tests are ideal. When they're not possible, pick the most reliable alternative — but never skip verification entirely.

中文直译: 这些准则生效的标志是：diff 里没必要的改动变少，因为过度复杂而返工变少，澄清性的提问出现在动手之前而不是出错之后。
出处: Karpathy Skills — Core Principles（译自 Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码陷阱的观察）
原文（英文逐字）: These guidelines are working if: fewer unnecessary changes in diffs, fewer rewrites due to overcomplication, and clarifying questions come before implementation rather than after mistakes.

中文直译: 让你的大模型用 ASD-STE100 来解释某件事，那是一套最初为航空维修文档开发的受控语言规范。模型很熟悉这套语言，而它自带对干净文风的强约束，我常常觉得这样读起来清楚得多。有时我会稍微放松一点，比如说「做到 ASD-STE100 的八成」，因为这套规范相当严格。
出处: X 帖：理解模型输出 / 四级输出形态
原文（英文逐字）: Ask your LLM to explain something in ASD-STE100, it's a controlled language specification originally developed for aerospace maintenance documentation. LLMs well-versed in this language and it comes with heavy constraints on clean writing style that I often find a lot more readable. Sometimes I've tried to soften it a bit e.g. ask for "80% of the way to ASD-STE100" because the spec is quite stringent.
来源文档: X 帖：理解模型输出 / 四级输出形态

中文直译: 图 / 图像。与其写，不如让你的大模型画一张图。图通常容易处理、解析和理解得多。
出处: X 帖：理解模型输出 / 四级输出形态
原文（英文逐字）: Diagrams / images. Instead of writing, ask your LLM to create a diagram. These can be a lot easier to process, parse, and understand.
来源文档: X 帖：理解模型输出 / 四级输出形态

中文直译: 网页。要求「以 HTML 输出」，就能得到一个漂亮、可交互的网页。大模型的前端能力正在变得很好，能做出漂亮的体验、动画等等。
出处: X 帖：理解模型输出 / 四级输出形态
原文（英文逐字）: Web pages. Ask for output "in HTML" to get a beautiful, interactive webpage. LLMs are getting really good at frontend and can create beautiful experiences, animations, etc.
来源文档: X 帖：理解模型输出 / 四级输出形态

中文直译: 讲解视频。我最看好的输出形态，是就任意题目现场生成的完全定制的讲解视频。可以这样试：「做一个 3b1b 风格的视频讲解 X。用我的 ElevenLabs API key 做配音。」
出处: X 帖：理解模型输出 / 四级输出形态
原文（英文逐字）: Explainer videos. The output format I am most bullish on is fully custom / bespoke explainer videos generated on any arbitrary topic. Experiment with things like "Create a 3b1b style video explainer on X. Use my ElevenLabs API key for audio narration".
来源文档: X 帖：理解模型输出 / 四级输出形态

中文直译: 这是我 DGX Spark 的本地 IP 和用户名密码。登录进去，配好 ssh key，装 vLLM，下载并跑 Qwen3-VL 的基准，起一个做视频推理的服务端接口、一个基础的网页仪表盘，把所有东西都测一遍，用 systemd 配成服务，给你自己记下备忘，再给我写一份 markdown 报告。
出处: X 帖：编程已经变了（DGX Spark 例子 / agentic engineering）
原文（英文逐字）: Here is the local IP and username/password of my DGX Spark. Log in, set up ssh keys, set up vLLM, download and bench Qwen3-VL, set up a server endpoint to inference videos, a basic web ui dashboard, test everything, it up with systemd, record memory notes for yourself and write up a markdown report for me
来源文档: X 帖：编程已经变了（DGX Spark 例子 / agentic engineering）

中文直译: 你是在把 AI agent 拉起来，用英文给它们派任务，并行地管理和审阅它们的工作。
出处: X 帖：编程已经变了（DGX Spark 例子 / agentic engineering）
